description: Calculate the combined UK tax on income from several sources in one tax year (employment, self-employment, rental profit, dividends and savings interest), allowing for PAYE tax already deducted: income tax, National Insurance, student loan, what is left to pay and take-home.

payeTaxDeducted.description: Income tax already deducted through PAYE

studentLoanPlan.description: Student loan plans held: one plan or a list of every plan, e.g. ["plan2", "postgrad"]. plan1 (pre-2012), plan2 (2012 onwards), plan4 (Scotland), plan5 (2023 onwards), postgrad (postgraduate loan, repaid alongside any other plan). Omit or "none" for no loan.

taxYear.description: UK tax year, e.g. "2026-27". Defaults to the current one.

name: calculate_tax_on_multiple_incomes
title: Calculate tax on several incomes
